description: Durable, database-owned continuation state: CANA remembers what must happen later, knows what it is waiting for, and wakes missions by time, event, condition, dependency, follow-up, revalidation or learning triggers. External runtimes tick it; none of them own it.
real_outcome: A conversation ending, a model failing, or a machine restarting never erases a future mission.
reversibility: Triggers cancel/expire; receipts are append-only and hash-chained (deliberately not erasable).

canonical_actions.description: Create a bounded trigger (rejected without purpose/stop/budget/ceiling/expiry)
The ONLY path arming EFFECTFUL work
Evaluate durable state (exactly-once firing; any runtime may invoke)

evidence_hooks: ContinuationReceipt hash chain per mission (tamper-evident, verifyReceiptChain)
worker JSONL audit line per cron tick (deploy/namecheap/worker.mjs continuation-tick job)
continuation_hooks: consumed by cana.ask-orderweeddc (FOLLOW_UP) and the provenance court (REVALIDATION)
backend_adapters: any runtime able to run node apps/web/scripts/continuation-tick.mjs
